_comment: Last-known tools/list of each plugin research service, served by scripts/evidence_proxy.py ONLY while its service has not answered `initialize` (cold start, outage) so the tools bind from the first turn; the live listing replaces it the moment the service answers (notifications/tools/list_changed). A session's own runtime cache (<DMA_RESEARCH_LAYER_STATE>/<service>.tools.json) wins over this file. Captured from a bound session on 2026-10-11. tests/test_evidence_proxy.py pins: every tool scripts/provision_agent_tools.py grants for these four families is listed here.

evidence.name: research_brief
evidence.description: Ranked evidence cards for one or more questions about an entity, plus a coverage block (novelty, saturation, conflict candidates, the ladder rungs searched). One call replaces a search → open → read → excerpt loop. BATCH A WHOLE CAPABILITY: pass `questions` as objects `{"question": "...", "subcap_ids": ["P1C1.1.1"], "facet": "primary"}` — one per cell question (and one per owed facet naming every cell it bears on). One search pass and one fetch slice serve them all; cards come back with `item.linked_subcap_ids` = the cells of the question each answered (the caller's ids, echoed, never invented) and `by_question[]` says which questions got no card. `max_cards`/`token_budget` are then per question. `entity`: {legal_name, domains[], aliases[], location, charter, cik, ticker}. `facet` ∈ works|fails|value|contradicts|corroborates (omit for all five). `subcap_labels` are opaque labels for logging only. A vendor name in a question is refused unless `allow_names_from_cards` maps it to the card_id it came from. `provenance` ∈ minimal|standard|full.

evidence.name: crawl_entity
evidence.description: Cards from the institution's OWN pages (sitemap + newsroom, press, careers, investor relations, disclosures; robots honoured; budget and depth capped) with a crawl manifest (seen, fetched, skipped, robots-blocked). `path_focus` ⊆ newsroom|careers|ir|disclosures|about.

evidence.name: filings_evidence
evidence.description: Cards anchored in 10-K/10-Q/8-K sections and XBRL facts with exact values and filing URLs (edgartools in-process, cached, 8 req/s global).

evidence.name: expand_context
evidence.description: The sentences around a card's span, ON DEMAND only — for disambiguation, a challenger check or a contradiction review.

evidence.name: verify_cards
evidence.description: Re-run liveness, verbatim-offset integrity, contract and date checks on cards. Used by the adversarial verifier and before promotion. Confidence only moves down.

evidence.name: coverage_report
evidence.description: Per-facet and per-label card counts, source diversity, single-source concentration (flag > 40%), recency distribution, open conflict candidates, saturation by facet, and the ladder rungs searched.

searxng.name: searxng_web_search
searxng.description: Searches the web using SearXNG and returns a list of results, each with a title, URL, and content snippet. CRITICAL: The required parameter name is exactly `query` (not `prompt`, `q`, or any other name). Use `pageno` to paginate results; combine `time_range` and `language` to narrow scope. To read the full text of a result URL, follow up with `web_url_read`.

engines.description: Comma-separated SearXNG engine names to query.

searxng.name: searxng_search_suggestions
searxng.description: Returns autocomplete suggestions from the configured SearXNG instance. Use this to refine vague or partial queries before searching.

searxng.name: searxng_instance_info
searxng.description: Discovers capabilities from all reachable configured SearXNG instances via /config, including categories, engines, defaults, locales, and plugins.

searxng.name: web_url_read
searxng.description: Fetches a URL and returns readable content as markdown. Three modes: full content (`startChar`/`maxLength` to paginate), section extraction (`section`), headings only (`readHeadings: true`). Returns an error string if the URL is unreachable or content cannot be extracted.

fetch.name: fetch
fetch.description: Fetches a URL from the internet and optionally extracts its contents as markdown.

edgar.name: search_companies
edgar.description: Search for companies by name in SEC records. Returns matching companies with CIK and ticker information.

edgar.name: get_cik_by_ticker
edgar.description: Convert a stock ticker symbol to its SEC CIK (Central Index Key).

edgar.name: get_company_facts
edgar.description: XBRL company facts for a ticker or CIK.

edgar.name: get_recent_filings
edgar.description: Get recent SEC filings for a company or across all filers (identifier optional; form_type, days, limit).

edgar.name: get_filing_sections
edgar.description: Extract specific sections (business, risk factors, MD&A) from a 10-K or 10-Q filing.

edgar.name: get_filing_content
edgar.description: Get the content of a specific SEC filing with paging support (offset, max_chars).

edgar.name: get_financials
edgar.description: Financial statements for a ticker or CIK (statement_type: all|income|balance|cash).

edgar.name: get_xbrl_concepts
edgar.description: XBRL concept values from a filing (accession_number, concepts, form_type).
